scope: Record the user's acceptance of the exact R01 account for documentary purposes and prepare one focused institutional clarification brief without contacts or further approvals.

preservation.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 concatenation of case-sensitive PowerShell-sorted absolute_full_path<TAB>length<TAB>uppercase_file_SHA256<LF> records, including hidden files; participant values were not parsed.
preservation.scope_limit: All existing tracked repository files and the complete prior audit-local tree were rehashed. External protected originals, mailbox contents, public websites and management-held documents were not re-examined in this acceptance/brief task; no operation wrote to them.

R04 consent scope and any additional permission
R10 institutional delegation and grant/publication/data rights
R12 use-specific conclusion and matters requiring R05-R09/R11 review

review_method: Same-agent source/scope review, 34 content/status checks, six negative controls and declared preservation fingerprints; not independent institutional/legal/coauthor validation.
